app.title: Mon Budget Familial
onboarding.title: Set up your budget in 3 steps
onboarding.body: Add your income, fixed bills and budget envelopes. The app can then calculate what you can safely spend.
dashboard.safeExplanation: After your bills, savings and protected provisions.
dashboard.deficitMissing: {amount} is still needed to protect this month.
dashboard.dailyOverBody: You are {amount} above the recommended pace.
dashboard.expectedIncomeNote: Not included in Safe to spend
dashboard.noEnvelopes: Create your first envelopes to decide where your money goes.
dashboard.disciplineEmpty: Add your data to get a score.
dashboard.weekOnTrack: Your current pace is compatible with your budget.
dashboard.weekTooFast: Your spending pace is too fast for your current budget.
budget.expectedNote: Not included in Safe to spend
budget.impossible: Budget not feasible: you allocated {amount} more than your current capacity.
budget.balanced: Budget balanced. You still have {amount} to allocate or keep as margin.
budget.empty: Create envelopes to decide where your money should go before you spend it.
budget.appliesFrom: This amount applies to {month} and the following months.
bills.remainingNote: This money is never counted as available
bills.label: Name
bills.firstMonthHint: This bill is due only from this month onward.
auth.noServer: No cloud server is configured in this version. The app continues to work locally.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Do not reuse an existing password.
auth.noAccount: I don't have an account yet
auth.privacy: Your financial data is isolated by account in the database, so other users cannot read it.
auth.created: Account created. If email confirmation is required, confirm it and then sign in.
delete.title: Delete my account
delete.mustSignIn: You must be signed in to the account you want to delete.
delete.body: You are about to delete {email} and its cloud data: income, bills, expenses, envelopes, savings, goals, provisions and synced settings.
delete.export: You can export a local backup before deletion from More → Backup.
delete.confirm: I understand that this deletion cannot be undone.
delete.failed: The deletion could not be confirmed. Check your connection and try again.
delete.after: After confirmation, the cloud account is deleted on the server and local data on this device is erased.
savings.goalProgress: {pct}% of your savings goal this month.
savings.rateBody: This amount is removed from Safe to spend as soon as income is recorded. This is the principle of saving before spending.
savings.noPockets: Create at least one pocket for your savings.
goals.title: Financial goals
goals.empty: A goal turns an idea into a clear monthly effort.
goals.late: The target date has passed and the amount has not been reached. Extend the deadline or adjust the target.
goals.noPocket: Without a savings pocket, a goal cannot progress automatically. Create one in Savings.
goals.label: Name
goals.pocket: Savings pocket linked to this goal
goals.pocketHint: The balance in this pocket automatically counts toward progress.
goals.initial: Amount already saved outside the pocket
more.deleteSubtitle: Permanently delete the account and cloud data
more.version: Mon Budget Familial · Financial Discipline V2
premium.title: Stay in control of your budget all year.
premium.body: Premium gives you advanced planning, analysis and cloud backup tools to support better financial discipline.
premium.signInFirst: Sign in first so Premium can be restored on a new device.
premium.androidOnly: Subscriptions are available in the Android version installed from Google Play.
premium.loadError: Unable to load Google Play offers.
premium.notAvailable: This offer is not available on Google Play yet.
premium.activated: Premium is now active on your account.
premium.restored: Your Google Play purchases have been restored.
premium.legal: Payment and cancellation are managed by Google Play. Premium access is granted only after server-side purchase validation.
profile.membersHint: Each expense can be assigned to a household member.
profile.currencyBody: Changing the currency only changes how amounts are displayed. Existing amounts are never converted automatically.
profile.envelopeAlertHint: The app warns you when this percentage of an envelope has been reached.
profile.pinBody: The PIN itself is never stored; only its hash is stored. It protects the app screen, not the local database, and does not replace your phone lock.
profile.noCloud: No cloud server configured. Your data remains on this device, so remember to export a backup.
profile.notSignedIn: You are not signed in, so nothing is backed up outside this device.
profile.badBackup: This file is not a Mon Budget Familial backup.
profile.importBody: Importing replaces all data currently stored on this device.
profile.resetWarning: This action erases all data on this device. Export a backup first.
profile.currencyWarning: Existing amounts will not be converted automatically. Only the monetary format used by your budget will change.
profile.pinMismatch: The two PINs do not match.
profile.languageAuto: Your phone language is used by default. A manual choice is saved on this device.
provisions.title: Plan ahead
provisions.body: Prepare for large future expenses before they are due. General savings and provisions are protected separately, and money already placed in a linked pocket is never counted twice.
provisions.monthReserve: Provisions still to fund this month
provisions.empty: No large expense planned yet. Start with something predictable such as insurance, school fees, travel or maintenance.
provisions.label: Expense to prepare for
provisions.pocketHint: Deposits in this pocket fund the provision and are not counted twice.
report.noData: no data to score this month
report.expectedNote: Not included in Safe to spend
report.empty: Record received income and a few expenses and your reports will fill automatically.
income.receivedNote: Only received income is included in Safe to spend
income.expectedNote: It remains excluded from Safe to spend until its date
income.empty: No income recorded for this month.
income.futureWarning: This income will be shown as expected and will not increase Safe to spend before {date}.
expense.dangerTitle: This expense puts your month at risk
expense.warningTitle: This expense weakens your monthly margin
expense.dangerBody: This expense cannot be considered safe given your received income, bills and protected savings.
expense.warningBody: This expense is still possible, but it reduces your margin or your recommended daily budget.
expense.envelopeWarning: The {name} envelope will reach at least {pct}%.
expense.envelopeOver: The {name} envelope will be over by {amount}.
expense.reasonRequired: Required to continue despite a deficit.
expense.reasonOptional: Optional, but useful when reviewing your decisions later.
expense.noEnvelopeHint: No envelope defined: this expense will be outside your budget envelopes.
lock.prompt: Enter your PIN to access your data.
lock.retry: Your data is still safe. Try again carefully.
visuals.addExpenses: Add a few expenses to see your spending pace.
visuals.envelopeEmpty: Create envelopes and add expenses to see how they are being used.
visuals.categoriesEmpty: Your spending categories will appear here.
visuals.monthlyAria: Comparison of income, expenses and savings over recent months
score.budgets.label: Budget discipline
score.budgets.detail: How well you stay within your envelope limits.
score.budgets.advice: Reduce the categories that exceed their budgets first.
score.epargne.label: Savings and provisions completed
score.epargne.detail: Progress toward protected savings and provisions.
score.epargne.advice: Protect the planned amount for your goals regularly.
score.charges.label: Bills paid on time
score.charges.detail: How consistently mandatory bills are paid by their due dates.
score.planification.label: Planned expenses
score.planification.detail: How much of your spending is linked to a plan or envelope.
score.planification.advice: Link recurring spending to an envelope.
score.safe_to_spend.label: Safe to spend discipline
score.safe_to_spend.detail: How well you respect your overall spending margin.
score.safe_to_spend.advice: Reduce or postpone expenses that trigger a global warning.
score.regularite.label: Tracking consistency
